review_note: Reviewed 2026-10-21 from user-supplied native occupations and AO coefficients. CASCI evidence at 2 and 30 angstrom in both bases: source 19/20 span the HSS frontier pair and 21/22 become the two singly occupied CH2 frontier orbitals. Far occupations are about 1.5095, 1.5050, 1.0000, 1.0000. Keep five frontier electrons in these four orbitals. Source 18/23 remains a largely filled/empty S-S pair (about 1.958/0.049 far). Two doublets and two quartets retain the diagnostic HSS frontier support; their asymptotic energies differ, so the 1.5/1.5 averaged occupations do not establish an exactly degenerate HSS ground state. Only D1 contributes reactive flux. These are orbital selections for normal production optimization, not a completed compact-CASSCF or correlated-potential validation. Production performs relaxation and spin splitting; no additional recon calculations are requested.

Additional state-averaged roots support orbital optimization and spin gaps; they are not additional reactive flux. No proof of excited-surface accessibility is implied.
